ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer and, upon written notice to IBM, its affiliates a nonexclusive license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.

ops.text: Customer may transfer this license to Customer's successor in an M&A transaction.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added affiliate coverage on written notice to IBM and struck "revocable" so the licence is not withdrawable at will, and gave Customer a transfer right to Customer's successor in an M&A transaction. This sits at our fallback position on licence scope.
proposal.summary: Extend Base Components licence to Customer affiliates on written notice and let Customer transfer it to Customer's M&A successor

mappings.element: Licence transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction.
